normal_session_acceptance.exclusion_rule: For a non-special observed date, fewer than 300 unique timestamps inside the eligible regular-session window causes DATA_GAP_EXCLUDED.
normal_session_acceptance.out_of_execution_rule: Observed source timestamps outside the execution window are never used for strategy decisions. They must be either covered by a documented date_control or be reported as UNRECONCILED.

acceptance_rules.special_session_rule: A special date is reconciled only when every documented F&O execution interval has at least one observed timestamp and every observed timestamp is either inside an execution interval or inside a documented source_observation_interval.
acceptance_rules.date_control_rule: Every explicitly controlled anomalous date must have a date_controls entry whose expected classification and policy are checked against the observed data.
acceptance_rules.unresolved_rule: The manifest contains no unresolved-date escape hatch. Any observed date not covered by a special_sessions rule, date_controls rule, or normal-session rule is emitted as UNRECONCILED and prevents G4 acceptance.
